schema.heights: { "<id>": metres } robust main-body height (90th percentile of mesh height above ground inside the footprint) for every building with mesh coverage >= 50 %
schema.buildings[\"<id>\"].src: "mesh" (height grid measured from the reality mesh) | "osm" (parts from OSM Simple-3D tags, only where there is no mesh)
schema.buildings[\"<id>\"].ground: ground elevation (m a.s.l., mesh datum) estimated from the ring 1..4.5 m outside the footprint; informational
schema.buildings[\"<id>\"].h: = heights[id]; hmax = absolute max (spire tips etc.)
schema.buildings[\"<id>\"].grid: {x0,z0,cell,w,h,scale,data}: cell (i,j) covers x in [x0+i*cell, x0+(i+1)*cell), z in [z0+j*cell, ...). data = base64 of byte pairs [count,value] (run-length). Decoded array length w*h, row-major (j*w+i). value 0 = outside the footprint / no cell; otherwise height above ground = (value-1)*scale metres. Walls are vertical at the footprint polygon (the renderer clips the roof surface to riga.json p).
schema.buildings[\"<id>\"].osm: same part schema as `parts`, taken from OpenStreetMap building:part ways (>= 2 parts) - hand-modelled, clean, preferred over fitted shapes when present; optional col = roof colour
schema.heightsP50: { "<id>": metres } median mesh height inside the footprint (volume-ish height; use for flat-roofed extrusions of pitched-roof buildings)
schema.buildings[\"<id>\"].parts: [{p:[[x,z]..] ring, y0,y1: metres above ground (prism from y0 to y1), roof:{shape,h,dir?}}]. roof.shape in flat|gabled|hipped|skillion|pyramid|cone|dome|onion; roof.h = roof rise above y1 (m); roof.dir = ridge direction in degrees from +x (east) towards +z (south) (gabled/hipped: ridge axis; skillion: the high side is to the left of this direction when facing along it, i.e. +90 deg). pyramid/cone/dome/onion are centred on the ring centroid and scale the ring to the apex. Optional col = "#rrggbb" roof colour.
schema.optional: wall / roofCol colour fields are not produced (textures not sampled in this spike)
